text:
Ana (Support): FYI customer (FinApps) just opened an escalation — embeddings endpoint throughput dropped ~3x starting ~1900001200. They say tokens/sec looks same but vectors/sec collapsed. Seeing client timeouts. 

Jordan (SRE): Can you paste the customer's request shape and a short curl? Also which model + variant?

Ana (Support): Sent privately to #secrets but public snippet: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' -d '{
  "model": "embed-1024-realtime",
  "input": ["...large batch..."],
  "max_batch_size": 64
}'

Ana (Support): They reported 100 tokens/sec stable, but vectors/sec went from ~1200 v/s to ~380 v/s. No config changes on client side.

Jordan (SRE): @Raj @Maya tagging — we saw a rollout at 1900001187 (deploy-bot). Deploy-bot: deploy finished: embed-1024-realtime @ canary -> prod. Could be related. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment embed-1024-realtime v12 -> prod completed at 1900001187 (canary 10%).

Raj (Eng-ML): I'll pull perf metrics. My hypothesis: continuous batching / padding change or quantization fallback causing larger effective batch dims, plus KV-cache misses.

Maya (Infra): On the cluster for customer tenant: instance pool ID pool-finapps-2. Observed queue depth spike at 1900001205 on g4-rx nodes. GPU util jumped to 97-100% and request tail latency spiked.

Jordan (SRE): Can you paste the nvml/gpu metrics and the per-request queue depth trace?

Maya (Infra): Logs (snip):
```
1900001204 worker-23 enqueue depth: 328
1900001205 worker-23 dequeue processed: 12
1900001205 gpu0 util: 99.1%
1900001206 kvcache miss ratio: 0.72
1900001207 avg_batch_dim: 1536
```

Raj (Eng-ML): avg_batch_dim 1536 is suspicious — model is 1024-dim. That implies padding / concatenation is causing extra dims (likely a new batching path bug adding per-batch token padding across sequences). If avg_batch_dim > model dim we end up running slower kernels and more memory pressure, leading to queueing.

Ana (Support): The customer also tried pinning concurrency to 8 and said it reduced errors but still poor v/s.

Jordan (SRE): Repro steps — Raj, can you try to repro on staging with synthetic load matching their token length distribution? We need to confirm whether it's kernel selection regression vs input dimension mismatch.

Raj (Eng-ML): Running now:
1) spawn 50 clients pushing variable-length inputs (mean tokens 512, tail 2048)
2) model: embed-1024-realtime:v12
3) client: max_batch_size 64, concurrency 16

Raj (Eng-ML): Quick results: tokens/sec stable but vectors/sec down ~3x when kvcache miss >0.5 and avg_batch_dim ~1500. Kernel profiler shows falling back to generic matmul path (slower) instead of quantized GEMM.

Jordan (SRE): That matches Maya's prod traces. Any config in v12 that touched batching or pad compaction?

Raj (Eng-ML): Yes — a change in batching code to de-duplicate short sequences across batches inadvertently introduced a code path that concatenates a metadata vector to the embedding dimension when there are more than 3 short sequences in a batch. It should have been a separate metadata tensor, not appended. So the runtime sees model dim=1024 vs input dim=1024+512 -> kernel mismatch. I'm 90% sure this is root cause.

Maya (Infra): Confirmed: memory footprint increases by ~40% on those batches, causing queue depth to explode.

Ana (Support): Customer wants quick mitigation — temporary workarounds?

Jordan (SRE): Short-term mitigations:
- Roll back v12 to v11 for embed-1024-realtime for affected tenants (canary->prod rollback).
- Apply per-tenant routing rule to force fallback to embed-1024-stable variant.
- Add a limit on max_batch_size to 16 for affected pool to reduce memory pressure.

Raj (Eng-ML): I can prepare a hotfix to stop appending metadata into embedding dim. But need code review + CI; likely 2-4 hours.

Maya (Infra): I'll enact routing rule and reduce pool max batch while Raj prepares the patch. Doing route change now: ops-bot: route change request for pool-finapps-2 -> embed-1024-stable.

ops-bot: Route change applied for pool-finapps-2 at 1900001260.

Jordan (SRE): Ana — can you tell customer we rolled routing and limited batch size? Ask them to validate: they should see vectors/sec recover and fewer timeouts.

Ana (Support): Pinged customer — they confirm initial improvement: vectors/sec up to ~900 v/s and timeouts gone for a minute, then small spikes remain. They reported some 502s earlier, now gone. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng-ML): Hotfix pushed to PR (link omitted) — stops concatenation and adds unit test for embedding dim invariants. Asking @Jordan for expedited canary.

Jordan (SRE): I'll canary the patch on 5% of traffic to prod in 15m, monitor gpu util, kvcache miss, avg_batch_dim. deploy-bot: starting canary deploy embed-1024-realtime v12.1 -> prod (5%).

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1900001298 (5%).

Maya (Infra): Monitoring: gpu util trending down to 70-80% on canary nodes, avg_batch_dim -> ~1024, kvcache miss stable.

Ana (Support): Customer reports steady vectors/sec at 1150 v/s after canary. They're relieved.

Jordan (SRE): If canary stays green for 30m we'll roll. Postmortem items:
- revert batching change in v12 (hotfix applied)
- add regression test that catches embedding-dim append bug
- telemetry alert for avg_batch_dim > model_dim*1.1
- per-tenant safeguard: auto-limit max_batch_size when queue depth > 200

Raj (Eng-ML): I will open RFC for batching semantics (metadata should never be appended) and add unit/integration tests.

Ana (Support): I'll update the customer and draft an incident message for status page.

Jordan (SRE): Assigning follow-ups:
- Raj -> fix & tests (PR already)
- Maya -> route/limits + monitor (done)
- Ana -> customer comms + incident note
- Jordan -> rollout and postmortem

Ana (Support): Thanks team. Keeping thread open until full prod roll completes. :pray:
